body:
## Recent Activity

The day was dominated by the Episode 4 release flow. @XenonMolecule opened [issue #31](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/31) requesting EP04 content for Ken Liu's episode on AI privacy. The agent ran two implementation passes: the first (PR #32) added episode and guest pages but lacked the cover image; after @XenonMolecule supplied the PNG, a second pass (PR #33) produced a self-contained PR with all three assets. [Issue #22](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/22) ("Update the .agent from the latest remote") was closed within the lookback window after earlier implementation work completed.

No discussions were active in this window.

## Recently Active PRs

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#33](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/33) — **feat: add Episode 4 — The Privacy Layer of Personal Intelligence with Ken Liu** (open, no reviews yet). Adds `content/episodes/ep04.md`, `content/people/ken-liu.md`, and `quartz/static/covers/EP04-cover.png`. Supersedes #32. Closes #31.
- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#32](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/32) — Same title (open). First-pass PR without cover image. AI review flagged: broken cover image reference (bypasses SVG fallback), missing `## Key Takeaways` section (present in EP00–EP03), and optional `guestOffset: 0` omission. Verdict: **MINOR_ISSUES**.

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#22](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/22) — **Update the .agent from the latest remote** (closed 2026-05-04). Agent synced `.agent/` and `.github/` from upstream, added `.skills/` and `AGENT.md` via PR #25.

No discussions were active in the synced window.

## Follow-ups

1. **Review and merge PR #33** — it is the complete EP04 implementation (content + cover image) but has not been reviewed yet. Before merging, verify whether the `## Key Takeaways` gap flagged on PR #32 was also carried into #33 (the agent's second pass carried over the same `ep04.md`).
2. **Close PR #32** — it is superseded by #33; leaving it open may cause confusion since both target `main` and close #31.
3. **Close issue #31** once PR #33 merges (it auto-closes via the `Closes #31` trailer, but confirm the PR is targeting the right base branch and the close fires correctly).
